home.heroTitlePart1: Live the day history was made,
home.lede: Each event is one real day from history, told from inside: you wake up, the alarm rings, and every decision until nightfall is yours. Play it the way it really happened, or bend it into one of several other endings, and learn what actually took place along the way.
home.indexHint: New events added one at a time
home.step1Desc: The Moon landing, the building of the Great Pyramid, and more to come. You are someone who was there, with a role, a cast and the real stakes of that day.
home.step2Desc: Every decision costs hours and resources and moves you through the scenes of the day. Complete your objectives, and read the historical note behind each moment.
home.step3Desc: History can go as it really did, or very differently. Each event hides several endings and dozens of facts to collect.
home.footer: Built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript

home.step4Title: Pass the exam, climb the ranks
home.step4Desc: At nightfall, a short exam on what you saw. Every right answer, new fact and ending earns experience: rise from Curious Visitor to Witness of the Ages, win medals, and keep your streak alive with today's challenge, the same day for everyone.
